query: A 55-year-old woman is rushed to the emergency department after being found lying unconscious in a burning house by a firefighter. No history can be obtained. Her vital signs include pulse 130/min and respirations 16/min. Physical examination reveals soot all over her face. Scattered wheezes can be heard on auscultation of the chest. A thorough survey of the body shows no evidence of any burn injuries. Which of the following changes in the oxygen-hemoglobin curve would most likely be expected in this patient?
